description: Returns one of Motion's authoring guides as text. 'motion' is the API contract: what compiles, resolves and renders — compositions written without it usually fail. 'motion-craft' covers timing and design so results do not look generated; 'motion-text' typography; 'motion-effects' named looks; 'motion-transitions' sequencing scenes; 'motion-examples' two contrasting complete pieces; 'motion-workflow' working while the user watches and checking frames; 'motion-review' a structured critique for pieces with an audience and a purpose.
name: read_skill
title: Read a Motion guide
